method: Every row of the registered-trials table (header '| ID |') in each research/*/trials.md, counted as written: rows never run (001, 002, 009 so far, this study's three until its history run) and rows carried over from another study (002's and 006's T1-T3 restate Study 001's rules; 006 ran them on a different sample) are all counted, so the figure is an upper bound on distinct rules. with_desk_registry adds every row of the desk's private registry (JSON lines), declaration and correction rows included, also an upper bound; that part cannot be checked by a reader. A case-insensitive search of every desk row for the family pattern finds whether any desk trial ranked industries or traded momentum. No decision weight: C3 is decided at N = 3 (§9.4).
